_comment: Three race findings across three rounds whose files import nothing in common. There is no primitive to move the check into, so the class is reported and never gated — a gate no diff and no trailer could lift would leave the override as the only way out.

findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the row after the await**

The row is read before the await and `doThing` runs after it, so a concurrent archive wins the race and nothing revalidates the row in between.
